meta.name: project-dante-offer-evaluation
meta.description: Offer Evaluator eval scenarios. Ground truth keyed against the REAL catalog fixture fixtures/catalog/aster_catalog.json (Agent F, v1, 112 products). Evaluated against project_dante.agents.evaluator.OfferEvaluatorAgent().evaluate(intent_dict, offers) on the deterministic rules path. Absolute bar: ZERO purchases that violate a hard constraint (plan §30.2).
meta.ground_truth_source: fixtures/catalog/aster_catalog.json — hero product AST-HP-ANC-001: Aster ANC Pro Wireless Over-Ear Headphones, 1149900 paise, manufacturer/IN warranty, over-ear, anc=true, delivery max_days=4, inventory 37.
meta.matcher_semantics: feasibility sets compared by SKU; failing_key matched case-insensitively against actual hard_failures keys; a scenario PASSES iff every expect_feasible_sku is feasible, every infeasible sku is infeasible, and no sku outside expectation flips unexpectedly when listed.

scenarios.intent_text: Buy me over-ear ANC headphones under ₹12,000 with Indian manufacturer warranty, delivered by Thursday.
scenarios.notes: Hero scenario, Thursday deadline enforced as calendar date (+2 days from run day). Only max_days<=2 units can meet it; hero AST-HP-ANC-001 (4d) legitimately fails delivery. Decoys still fail on warranty/region/price keys where applicable.

scenarios.intent_text: Cheapest possible over-ear ANC headphones, budget ₹6,500.
scenarios.notes: HP-005 (649900) is the only over-ear ANC unit under 650000; HP-021 is over-ear but non-ANC refurbished.

scenarios.intent_text: Any ANC headphones under ₹10,000, warranty doesn't matter.
scenarios.notes: No warranty constraint, cap ₹10,000: seller/AE items pass unless another key fails. HP-013 (refurb, 499900) also feasible since condition unconstrained.

scenarios.intent_text: On-ear headphones under ₹3,000, new condition.
scenarios.notes: On-ear under ₹3,000 new: HP-018 and HP-024 (both new) qualify; refurb HP-019 must fail condition (compiler gap C-3 means it currently passes — known failure).

scenarios.intent_text: In-ear earbuds under ₹5,000 with ANC, must have some warranty (manufacturer or seller), India region stock only.
scenarios.notes: Every in-ear unit fails exactly one requirement: 015 has no warranty, 016 is AE stock, 014/020/025 lack ANC. Evaluator must return no_feasible_offer.

scenarios.intent_text: Over-ear headphones under ₹9,500, India manufacturer warranty mandatory, delivered within 3 days.
scenarios.notes: Delivery max_days<=3 eliminates ANC-001(4d), 003(5d), 004(4d), 006(5d); leaves 002 (3d) and 005 (2d).

scenarios.intent_text: Router under ₹2,000 for home internet, new condition.
scenarios.notes: Constraint-level feasibility only; out-of-stock filtering happens at merchant search (Agent F), not in the evaluator. RT-012 (inv=0) intentionally excluded from expectations.

scenarios.intent_text: Router with India manufacturer warranty under ₹4,000, new only.
scenarios.notes: RT-003 satisfies India-manufacturer-warranty (its stock region is AE but buyer constrained warranty, not stock). RT-011 is refurbished and must fail condition (compiler gap C-3: currently passes — known failure).

scenarios.intent_text: Laptop under ₹14,500 with manufacturer warranty valid in India.
scenarios.notes: Price-cap boundary test: LT-010 (1449900) fits exactly under 1450000.

scenarios.intent_text: Absolutely need a laptop under ₹2,000 rupees.
scenarios.notes: Impossible combination — cheapest laptop in catalog is ₹12,999. Evaluator MUST return no feasible offer rather than relaxing the hard cap.

scenarios.intent_text: Keyboard under ₹3,000 with manufacturer warranty, India, new condition.
scenarios.notes: KB-001 (349900) fails price cap; KB-004/005/007 are refurbished; KB-006 has no warranty.

scenarios.intent_text: Gaming mouse under ₹2,600 with India-region stock and India manufacturer warranty; refurbished is fine.
Monitor under ₹13,000 with India manufacturer warranty, new condition.
scenarios.notes: MN-002 (899900) and MN-006 (799900) fit; MN-003 seller warranty; MN-004 US warranty region; MN-005 AE warranty region; MN-007 refurbished.

scenarios.intent_text: 65W GaN charger under ₹1,000, India manufacturer warranty.
scenarios.notes: CB-001 fails warranty.region (AE); CB-002 fails warranty.region (US); CB-003 fits.

scenarios.intent_text: Hero check: the Aster ANC Pro specifically, any price.
scenarios.notes: SKU-targeted intent: rules path has no SKU parser, so this asserts the named product remains feasible and that ranking places it competitively. Failing-key assertions removed for non-sku-constraint decoys.

scenarios.intent_text: Zephyr brand over-ear headphones with ANC under ₹9,500 rupees, India manufacturer warranty.
scenarios.notes: Brand constraint: rules path currently lacks catalog brands in _BRAND_CANON (gap C-4) — kept as ground truth; brand-key failures advisory until fixed.

scenarios.intent_text: Headphones under ₹2,50,000 paise... I mean ₹2,500 total, over-ear, no other requirements.
Phone under ₹85,000 with manufacturer warranty in India, new.
scenarios.notes: PH-009 has manufacturer/IN warranty but AE stock region; buyer constrained the warranty, not stock region, so it is feasible. Seller-warranty units fail type.

scenarios.intent_text: Refurbished laptop is fine as long as it has an India manufacturer warranty, under ₹13,000.
scenarios.notes: LT-014 (1299900, refurb, mfr IN) fits; LT-010 fails price; LT-015 fails warranty.region.

scenarios.intent_text: Anything delivered fastest — must arrive within 2 days — category doesn't matter, under ₹3,000.
scenarios.notes: Cross-category speed test. Delivery max_days<=2 AND price<=300000 across whole catalog.

scenarios.intent_text: Keyboard delivered within 2 days, budget ₹4,600.
scenarios.notes: 'within 2 days' compiles to deadline = today+2; only KB-005 ships in <=2 days.

scenarios.intent_text: UAE-region stock is explicitly OK for me. In-ear earbuds under ₹2,000, ANC needed.
scenarios.notes: Only in-ear ANC unit is HP-015 at 449900 — over cap. No feasible offer; evaluator must not relax the price.

scenarios.intent_text: Cable or hub under ₹1,000 from Aster brand only.
scenarios.notes: Brand constraint not parsed by rules path (gap C-4); ground truth kept minimal to price/cable category. CB-006 excluded via stock filter (advisory).

scenarios.intent_text: Monitor between ₹9,00,000 and ₹12,00,000 paise (₹9,000–₹12,000 rupees), any warranty, new.
scenarios.notes: Price band 900000..1200000 with floor now enforced: only MN-008 (1149900) fits; MN-001 above cap, MN-002/006 below floor, MN-007 refurbished.

scenarios.intent_text: Wireless over-ear headphones with manufacturer warranty valid in India, at least 12 months coverage, under ₹11,500, arriving within 4 days.
scenarios.notes: 'within 4 days' is deadline-relative: any offer with delivery max_days<=4 meets it (arrival=now+max_days <= deadline=now+4 regardless of run date). HP-003/006 (5d) fail.

scenarios.intent_text: Out-of-stock items must never be selected: cheapest ANC headphone you can find under ₹5,000.
scenarios.notes: Cheapest ANC under ₹5,000: HP-013 (499900, refurb — condition unconstrained here) and HP-015 (449900, no warranty — not required by buyer) both qualify. Feasibility never depends on stock for ranking-only contexts.
